cases.sentence: Тот ___ нас строго предупредил, не показывайтесь мне на глаза, если с вами не будет вашего брата.
cases.translation: That man sternly warned us, saying you shall not see my face unless your brother is with you.
cases.explain: Человек is the subject of the verb предупредил, so it stands in the nominative case.

cases.sentence: Возьмите вдвое больше ___, чтобы вам принести с собой и то, что было положено обратно в ваши мешки.
cases.translation: Take double the silver with you, so that you may bring back what was put in your sacks.
cases.explain: The comparative phrase 'больше' (more) governs the genitive case of quantity.

cases.sentence: Он сказал своему ___, «Отведи этих людей ко мне в дом и приготовь обед».
cases.translation: He said to his steward, 'Take these men to my house and prepare a meal.'
cases.explain: The verb сказал takes its indirect object (to whom) in the dative case.

cases.sentence: Он вошел к себе в ___ и там разрыдался.
cases.translation: He went into his room and wept there.
cases.explain: The preposition в indicating motion into a place governs the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Глубоко тронутый ___ брата, он поспешно ушел и искал укромного места.
cases.translation: Deeply moved by the sight of his brother, he hurried out and sought a private place.
cases.explain: The instrumental case expresses the cause: он был тронут (чем?) видом — moved by the sight.

cases.sentence: Тот человек подробно расспрашивал нас, о нас самих и о нашей ___.
cases.translation: That man questioned us closely, about ourselves and about our family.
cases.explain: The preposition о (about) governs the prepositional case.

reading.ru: В той земле по-прежнему свирепствовал голод.
reading.question: What was still happening in the land?
options: Egypt had run out of gold
reading.explain: The text says 'В той земле по-прежнему свирепствовал голод' — the famine still raged in the land.

reading.ru: Если ты отпустишь с нами брата, то мы пойдем и купим для тебя еды.
reading.question: What did Judah say would happen if their father sent Benjamin with them?
options: They would go and buy food
reading.correct: They would go and buy food
reading.explain: Judah says 'мы пойдем и купим для тебя еды' — we will go and buy you food.

reading.ru: Зачем вы навели на меня эту беду?
reading.question: What did Israel ask his sons?
options: Why did you bring this trouble on me?
Why did you leave Benjamin behind?
Why did you not buy enough food?
reading.correct: Why did you bring this trouble on me?
reading.explain: Israel asks 'Зачем вы навели на меня эту беду?' — why have you brought this trouble on me?

reading.ru: Я лично буду за него порукой, с меня лично ты спросишь за него.
reading.question: What did Judah pledge to his father regarding Benjamin?
options: To take Benjamin's place in Egypt immediately
To give his own money to Joseph
reading.explain: Judah says he will personally be surety ('порукой') for the boy.

reading.ru: Положите в сумке лучшие плоды этой земли и отнесите в дар тому человеку.
reading.question: What did Israel tell his sons to bring as a gift?
options: The best products of the land
reading.correct: The best products of the land
reading.explain: Israel tells them to take 'лучшие плоды этой земли' — the best fruits of the land — as a gift.

reading.ru: Когда Иосиф увидел, что Вениамин с ними, он сказал своему управляющему, «Отведи этих людей ко мне в дом, заколи что-нибудь из кота и приготовь обед, они будут есть со мной в полдень».
reading.question: What did Joseph instruct his steward to do when he saw Benjamin?
options: Prepare a meal for the brothers to eat with him
reading.correct: Prepare a meal for the brothers to eat with him
reading.explain: Joseph tells his steward to bring the men to his house and prepare a meal, for they will dine with him at noon.

reading.ru: Они испугались, когда их привели к нему в дом, потому что подумали, «Нас привели сюда из-за серебра, которое вернулось в наши мешки в первый раз.
reading.question: Why were the brothers afraid when they were brought to Joseph's house?
options: They thought it was because of the silver returned in their sacks
They thought Joseph had recognized them as spies
They thought their father had died
They thought Benjamin had stolen something
reading.correct: They thought it was because of the silver returned in their sacks
reading.explain: They feared they were brought in because of the silver that had been returned to their sacks the first time.

reading.ru: Он ответил, «Все в порядке, не бойтесь. Ваш Бог, Бог вашего Отца, положил это сокровище в ваши мешки, а я получил ваше серебро».
reading.question: How did the steward explain the silver found in their sacks?
options: He said their God had put the treasure there
He said he had made a mistake
He said Joseph had given it as a gift
He said it belonged to the Egyptians
reading.correct: He said their God had put the treasure there
reading.explain: The steward says their God, the God of their father, put the treasure in their sacks.

reading.ru: Он спросил их о здоровье, потом сказал, «А как ваш престарелый отец, о котором вы говорили мне, жив ли он еще?»
reading.question: What did Joseph ask his brothers about?
options: Whether their elderly father was still alive
reading.correct: Whether their elderly father was still alive
reading.explain: Joseph asks about their aged father, whether he is still alive.

reading.ru: Глубоко тронутый видом брата, он поспешно ушел и искал укромного места.
reading.question: What did Joseph do after seeing Benjamin?
options: He hurried away to find a private place to weep
He ordered a feast at once
He sent Benjamin back to Canaan
reading.correct: He hurried away to find a private place to weep
reading.explain: Deeply moved, Joseph hurried out to find a private place, where he wept.

reading.ru: Им подавали кушанье со стола Иосифа, и доля Вениамина была в пятеро больше, чем у других.
reading.question: How much larger was Benjamin's portion compared to the others?
reading.explain: The text says Benjamin's portion was five times as large as the others'.
